title: Invoice Pack
description: Phase 4.8 — a versioned invoice generated from the deal's contract-derived invoice schedule + agency invoice template. Lighter weight than contract pack (most fields deterministic; 0-1 LLM passes). Multiple invoice packs per deal supported via `deal.close.invoice_schedule[]` (e.g. 50/50 NET-30 produces 2 invoice packs). Each pack fires when its `trigger_condition` is met (contract_executed / all_deliverables_live / first_post_live / specific_date / manual). Agent reviews rendered PDF before sending. Sending is the approval — no separate gate (lighter than contract's legal review). Payment tracked manually in v0.1; v2 webhooks from Stripe/Xero/QuickBooks auto-populate. Stored at `data/deals/{deal_id}/invoice_packs/v{N}.json` (gitignored). See `docs/invoice_workflow.md`.

invoice_pack_id.description: Globally unique. Format: `inv_{deal_id_short}_seq{N}_v{M}` where N is the schedule_sequence (which entry in invoice_schedule this fulfils) and M is the version (revisions to this specific invoice). Example: `inv_2026_q2_alo-yoga_jane-doe_seq2_v1` = second scheduled invoice for the deal, first version.

schedule_sequence.description: Which entry in `deal.close.invoice_schedule[]` this invoice fulfils. For a single-invoice deal this is always 1. For 50/50 split it's 1 (upfront) or 2 (completion).

is_latest.description: Exactly one is_latest=true per (deal_id, schedule_sequence). When a v2 of invoice seq=2 is generated, v1 of seq=2 flips to false but v1 of seq=1 is untouched.

trigger.description: schedule_trigger_fired: cron detected the schedule entry's trigger_condition met (e.g. all_deliverables_live). agent_initiated: agent manually fired (e.g. for `manual` trigger entries). agent_regenerate: NL feedback regen of this invoice. brand_revision_request: brand asked for a change (line item description, tax adjustment) → new version. amendment_invoice: post-execution amendment created a new invoice via the contract amendment_log flow.

trigger_condition_fired.description: Which condition from the invoice_schedule entry actually fired. Captured for audit.

fired_at.description: When the trigger condition was met (vs `generated_at` which is when generation completed).

generated_by_agent_id.description: Agent who triggered. Null/absent for cron-triggered (schedule_trigger_fired) generations.

llm_model.description: Only present if any LLM passes ran (e.g. narrative line item drafting). Many invoices generate with 0 LLM passes.

contract_pack_id_at_gen.description: Which executed contract pack version this invoice was generated against. Anchors line-item descriptions + amounts to the contract that authorised them.

talent_billing_entity_snapshot.description: Frozen copy of `talent.billing_entity` at generation time. Talent legal-name changes after invoice generation don't retroactively rewrite issued invoices.

brand_legal_entity_snapshot.description: Frozen copy of `contract_pack.context_snapshot.brand_legal_entity_at_gen`. Same anchoring rationale.

agency_invoice_template_version.description: Value of `agency_profile.invoice_template.template_version` at generation. Template changes don't retroactively rewrite issued invoices.

invoice_schedule_entry_snapshot.description: Frozen copy of the `deal.close.invoice_schedule[sequence]` entry being fulfilled.

matched_posts.description: If trigger_condition involved post detection (first_post_live / all_deliverables_live), captures the matched posts. Each entry references the posting_schedule[] entry that triggered.

merge_field_values.description: Same shape as contract_pack.merge_field_values[]. Each value tagged with field, value, source, confidence. Invoice merge fields are highly deterministic (legal names, amounts, dates pulled from contract + talent + agency) — `low`/`missing` confidence on critical fields surfaces before send.

line_items.description: Line items composing the invoice. Auto-generated from the schedule entry's percentage applied to deal.proposal.fee_usd, broken down per deliverable. LLM optionally drafts the `description` text if the agency template uses `{{narrative_line_items}}` placeholder.

deliverable_ref.description: Reference to `deal.proposal.deliverables[].` entry this line item represents. Null for non-deliverable line items (e.g. expense reimbursement).

description.description: Human-readable line item. LLM-drafted or template-default.

amount_usd.description: quantity × unit_price_usd. Computed; redundant for clarity in rendered output.

narrative_drafted_by_llm.description: True if description was LLM-generated. False if template-default or agent-edited.

amounts.description: Computed totals. subtotal_usd = sum of line_items[].amount_usd. tax handling per agency_profile.invoice_template.tax_handling.

tax_label.description: What this tax is called on the rendered invoice (e.g. 'VAT', 'Sales Tax', 'GST').

fx_rate_to_usd.description: If the deal's contract specifies a non-USD currency, this captures the FX rate used at generation. Both the original currency amount and the USD-normalised amount may be rendered.

composed_markdown.description: Final composed invoice markdown — agency template with merge fields substituted, line_items table inserted, amounts table inserted, payment instructions appended. Source-of-truth for the PDF render.

agent_review.description: Soft gate. Agent reviews rendered PDF + can edit any merge field / line item / template content. Edits regenerate the PDF. Clicking 'Send' sets sent_at — sending IS the approval (no separate 'approve' event like contracts). All fields optional — absence of `sent_at` means the invoice is still in draft.

viewed_at.description: When agent first opened the rendered PDF.

sent_at.description: When agent clicked Send. ABSENT = invoice is in draft state. Setting this transitions payment_state.status from `draft` to `sent`.

send_method.description: v0.1: always manual_email (agent emails the PDF). v2: API-driven send via Stripe Invoices / Xero / QuickBooks auto-populates this + the external invoice_id.

sent_to_email.description: Recipient on the brand side. Captured for audit + reminder follow-up.

type.description: v0.1: markdown source + PDF only. No Word — invoices are typically PDF-only artefacts.

payment_state.description: Payment lifecycle for this specific invoice. Multiple invoice packs per deal each track independently. The deal's auto-archive trigger requires ALL invoices to have status=paid.

status.description: draft: agent hasn't sent yet. sent: agent_review.sent_at set, awaiting payment. viewed_by_brand: v2 only (Stripe/etc. webhook for invoice viewed). paid: payment_received_at set. overdue: due_at < now and not paid. disputed: brand has formally disputed (agent sets manually). void: invoice cancelled.

due_at.description: Payment due. Computed as sent_at + agency_profile.invoice_template.default_payment_terms_days (or schedule_entry.payment_terms_days override). Used by overdue cron.

payment_received_at.description: v0.1: agent sets manually when funds confirmed. v2: webhook from Stripe/Xero/QuickBooks auto-populates.

payment_amount_received_usd.description: Actual amount received (may differ from amounts.total_usd due to FX or partial payment). If partial, status stays `sent` with a reconciliation_note explaining.

payment_reference.description: Bank transaction reference / Stripe charge ID / wire reference. For reconciliation.

external_invoice_id.description: v2: Stripe invoice id / Xero invoice id / etc. when sent via external provider.

reconciliation_note.description: Free-text for partial payment / fx adjustment / written-off remainder explanations.

payment_reminder_log.description: Audit trail of overdue follow-ups. Daily overdue cron appends `agent_notification` entries; agent appends `agent_email_sent` / `phone_followup` / `escalation` entries when they act.

agent_edits.description: Direct edits to invoice fields. Edits before send don't increment version (draft mutability). Edits after send create a new version (sent invoices are immutable — must void + re-issue).
